headline: Congress named a Detroit Postal Service building after the singer Aretha Franklin.
what_it_does: This law renames a specific U.S. Postal Service facility at 12711 East Jefferson Avenue in Detroit, Michigan, as the Aretha Franklin Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff rules.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was enacted on January 5, 2021.
